properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: keccak256 (Ethereum's pre-FIPS-202 Keccak variant) is the app's own hashing: hashMessage (EIP-191 personal-message envelope) and hashTypedDataMessage (EIP-712 via eth-sig-util TypedDataUtils.hashStruct) both feed keccak-256 digests into ECDSA recovery. Quantum-safe as a hash (Grover gives only square-root speedup); A- rating justified.
